Veai AI Agent

Install with the Veai installer, then run veai:
  veai install [--channel stable|dogfood]        install or update the managed installation
Or run a pinned version without installing:
  npx -y @veai-ru/ai-agent@<version>            start the terminal UI
  npx -y @veai-ru/ai-agent@<version> tui        start the terminal UI
  npx -y @veai-ru/ai-agent@<version> login      store a provider credential
  npx -y @veai-ru/ai-agent@<version> logout     remove stored credentials

Commands: veai tui | login | logout | plugin | install | update | config
  veai update        update the managed installation now (same as install)
  veai config set updateChannel stable|dogfood | autoUpdate true|false | cacheWarming off|streaming|idle
  veai plugin        manage Marketplace plugins (veai plugin help)
  --permission-mode default|paranoid|bypassPermissions   start the terminal UI in that mode
  -h, --help         show this message
  -v, --version      print the version

Credentials and sessions are separate from other agents: logging in to a pi you run
by hand does not log in here, so run login once for this agent.
The terminal UI notes a newer version at startup.
VEAI_OFFLINE=1 turns off the update check and the model catalogue refresh (PI_OFFLINE
no longer stops the update check). Model, web, MCP and Telegram requests and usage telemetry
still go out.
IDE (ACP) integration is set up by the Veai installer, which places the adapter
next to this package; it is not part of this package.
